newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GLAMORGAN SIGN WESTERN PROVINCE COACH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GLAMORGAN SIGN WESTERN PROVINCE COACH.

text.p: Western Province cricket coach Duncan Fletcher is to take up an off-season post with English county championship side Glamorgan.
Western Province will release Fletcher at the end of the South African season until September 16 when he will resume his post at Newlands.
"I have agreed a one-year contract with a provisional arrangement for a second year," Fletcher said.
"They approached me and it has been a longheld ambition of mine to coach over there."

Zimbabwe-born Fletcher is widely regarded as the best provincial coach in South Africa. He was with the 'A' team on their tour of England in July and August when they played and defeated Glamorgan in three days.
